name: sj-svalbard-visitor-environmental-levy
description: Determine and reconcile the Svalbard visitor environmental levy for 2026. Covers the per-person charge, ticket collection, private-boat payment, permanent-resident exemption and refund, personal versus employer-paid travel, the refund deadline, evidence and enforcement. Use for Svalbard environmental fee, miljøavgift, cruise tickets and resident travel refunds. Does not extend to Jan Mayen or substitute for aviation-specific exceptions. Builds a person-and-journey reconciliation from actual charges and completed travel evidence, identifies the eligible claimant, and separates the personal refund from the employer agreement route. Flags carrier settlement procedures and form fields beyond the public access screen as unverified. Produces calculation and evidence working papers for professional review, not a submitted claim or a guarantee of eligibility.
